ms.report:
COSMEX Milestone 3: Proof of Achievement
Deliverables and Evidence
✅ State Channel Smart Contract
Implementation:
・Smart contract: CosmexValidator.scala
・Features: 4-phase state machine (Open → SnapshotContest → TradesContest → Payout), 7 redeemers, Ed25519 signature verification, balance preservation, trade execution validation

✅ PoC Exchange Implementation
Implementation:
・Server: Server.scala - Core exchange logic
・WebSocket Server: CosmexWebSocketServer.scala - Real-time trading
・WebSocket Client: SimpleWebSocketClient.scala
・Transaction Builder: CosmexWebSocketServer.scala - On-chain operations
・Features: WebSocket API, order matching (price-time priority), multi-client support, snapshot signing

Channel Opening & Off-Chain Trading
We use Preprod instead of Preview as it's more suitable for this type of testing.
・Channel opening with dual signatures and initial snapshot (v0):
・Alice's Channel opening tx: https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/56f68c2408147319bde6f5deb734283b983f5e0722c0497a29f19fc5a813f5ab
・Bob's Channel opening tx: https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/302c15848a9da4fc20b6cf1c399240b3aba1cdc67651104c0858516ea0d454a6
・Limit order implementation (BUY/SELL) with automatic matching Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7XQOaOktvQ
・Test suite
・Whitepaper
・Whitepaper PDF
・Litepaper
・Litepaper PDF
